reasons: The cited Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority representations plus the Globix acknowledgement — no professional/workmanlike, conformance, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy — so the clause fails the WARRANTY fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies); 'missing express warranty is a deviation (insert)' is the correct classification.
Party roles are correctly mapped: HDI is the service provider/vendor and the Company (our alias) is the customer, so the inserted warranty runs in our favour and is not an over-flag.

The inserted 9(c) is an additive, minimal edit that leaves p0055–p0058 untouched and reaches the preferred position (workmanlike standard, 90-day conformance, compliance with laws, no malicious code, repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at HDI's option).
The failed deterministic check on warranty duration is a regex artifact — the inserted text expressly states 'a period of ninety (90) days', which satisfies the parameter.

Minor, non-fatal: the comment offers a 'ninety (90) day conformance period ... as a fallback' when 90 days is already what the redline inserts — the fallback offer should instead reference a shorter period (or be dropped). Also consider running the 90 days from Site launch/delivery rather than the Effective Date, since the Site may not be operational at signing (see Section 1.6).
